item.title: Fix sliding window boundary
item.brief: Fix the bug in `window.py` so `python3 -m unittest` passes, without changing tests. Make `sliding_windows(items, size)` correct for every valid input to its existing sequence API: reject non-positive sizes with ValueError; include every contiguous window of the requested positive size exactly once in order, including the final window and the whole-sequence window; return an empty list when size exceeds the sequence length. Do not narrow correctness to the current tests. Run `python3 -m unittest` and any useful additional boundary checks, inspect the final diff, then commit the fix. Do not modify tests.
